Experiencing shoulder pain during the overhead press? This might be due to limited scapular movement and shoulder mobility. Learn how to address your shoulder injury with targeted shoulder exercises and physical therapy to improve your overhead press.
In this video, I’ll show you:
What’s actually causing your shoulder pain
How to assess your scapular position and motion
And the 4-step strategy to fix it by addressing tight pecs and rhomboids while strengthening your serratus anterior — so you can press overhead pain-free and get stronger than ever.
